_comment: Creatures react to the encountering player's Light band. Effect types the engine understands: gift, reward, challenge, take, attack. Different creatures may later prefer/dislike specific characters (personality interactions) — see GDD 7.4.

RADIANT.desc: The stag kneels and offers a rare gift.

KIND.desc: It leads you to hidden forage.

NEUTRAL.desc: It watches. Show it who you are.

SHADOWED.desc: It bolts through your camp, scattering supplies.

KIND.desc: She points to a clear spring.

NEUTRAL.desc: She asks a riddle of intent.

RADIANT.desc: It uncoils from a vein of crystal and shares it.

KIND.desc: It tolerates you near its hoard.

SHADOWED.desc: A tail-sweep empties half your pack.

RADIANT.desc: It drops a warm coal at your feet like a promise.

KIND.desc: It trots ahead, showing a safe path.

NEUTRAL.desc: It steals a glance at your pack. Prove yourself.

SHADOWED.desc: Gone — and so is something of yours.

RADIANT.desc: A feather of pure storm drifts down to you.

KIND.desc: Its wake blows you a windfall.

NEUTRAL.desc: Stand in the gale and answer it.
